messages:
nora: quick note - after forcing a 401 in the node quickstart, subsequent retries show req_id empty and redact=false.

sam: paste snippet?

nora:
```
2025-03-05T08:01:01Z INFO outgoing req path=/v1/chat req_id=abc123
2025-03-05T08:01:01Z WARN auth status=401
2025-03-05T08:01:02Z INFO retry auth ok
2025-03-05T08:01:02Z INFO outgoing req path=/v1/chat req_id=\"\" redact=false
```
\notel-bot: CI flaky: telemetry/reqid-preserve failed on main. https://ci.internal/runs/9402

qa: this smells like the retry path drops custom headers. OTEL traceparent is present but our X-Request-ID header is not.

sam: likely hook ordering + retry implementation. short-term mitigation: treat missing req_id as sensitive and default redact=true in the telemetry hook.

nora: i'll open a sample-app PR to copy headers on retry; sam can follow up with an SDK change to always preserve outgoing headers during auth refresh.

qa: add a CI integration that injects a 401 and asserts X-Request-ID preserved after retry and redact remains true.

sam: agreed. i'll add unit tests and a staging smoke to verify ingress (nginx) doesn't strip custom headers on auth flows.

nora: thanks all, will link PRs when ready.
